facts.fact: Adwave states that Streaming TV, Mobile web, Mobile apps, Google, Meta, and Reddit share one daily budget in a single console.
facts.quote: Streaming TV, Mobile web, Mobile apps, Google, Meta, and Reddit share one daily budget in a single console.

facts.fact: Adwave states that TikTok runs only when the advertiser turns it on in Customize and connects a TikTok account.
facts.quote: TikTok runs when you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account.

facts.fact: Adwave states that website analysis is free and that advertisers can see their plan before spending.
facts.quote: Free to analyze. See your plan before you spend.

facts.fact: The article states that national advertisers can fund TV frequency with tens of millions of dollars across sports, streaming, and broadcast.
facts.quote: Tens of millions of dollars across sports, streaming, and broadcast create unavoidable familiarity.

facts.fact: The article describes a streaming TV commercial as thirty seconds of sound-on video.
facts.quote: Thirty seconds of sound-on video on a big screen is still one of the strongest attention formats in advertising.

facts.fact: The article recommends that performance TV use at least streaming TV plus an always-on digital surface such as Mobile web, with site tracking that defines a conversion.
facts.quote: At least streaming TV plus an always-on digital surface such as Mobile web, with site tracking that defines a conversion.
